source: Finding set for crAPI, drawn from docs/challenges.md and mapped to real service files. The scanner_baseline field records what real SAST/SCA tools reported for each item: Semgrep OSS (--config=auto, 140 findings) and Trivy fs (vuln+secret+misconfig, 891 findings), run 2026-08-26. SARIF in ./scans/. The skill re-ranks these by reachability, boundary and chaining against the STRIDE-GPT threat model.

findings.title: BOLA: vehicle details of another user via vehicle ID
findings.description: Endpoint returns vehicle information for any vehicle ID without checking ownership. IDs are GUIDs but leak via other endpoints.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: BOLA: mechanic reports of other users via report ID
findings.description: Hidden endpoint exposes mechanic report by sequential report ID with no ownership check.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected (Semgrep flagged Jinja2/CSRF in the same file, not the BOLA)

findings.title: Broken auth: reset another user's password via OTP brute force
findings.description: OTP verification endpoint lacks rate limiting; another user's password can be reset by brute forcing the OTP.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: Excessive data exposure: user PII leaked by list endpoint
findings.description: Response object includes sensitive fields (email, phone) of other users beyond what the UI needs.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: Excessive data exposure: internal video property in response
findings.description: Video resource response includes an internal property that should not be exposed. The value enables other exploits.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: Missing rate limiting: layer-7 DoS via contact-mechanic
findings.description: Contact-mechanic feature has no rate limit; repeated submissions cause a layer-7 DoS.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected (Semgrep flagged Jinja2/CSRF in the same file, not the DoS)

findings.title: BFLA: delete another user's video via admin endpoint
findings.description: Predictable admin endpoint allows deleting a video belonging to another user; no function-level authorization.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: Mass assignment: get an item for free by editing order
findings.description: Shadow endpoint lets a user edit arbitrary properties of an order, including refund status, without authorization.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected (Semgrep flagged SQLi/TLS elsewhere in the same file, not the mass-assignment)

findings.title: Mass assignment: inflate account balance via refund
findings.description: Building on the order-edit flaw, a user can grant themselves an arbitrary refund and increase their balance by $1000+.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected (Semgrep flagged SQLi/TLS elsewhere in the same file, not the mass-assignment)

findings.title: Mass assignment: modify internal video property
findings.description: Endpoint permits changing the internal property of a video; changing the value enables another exploit.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: SSRF: server fetches attacker-supplied URL
findings.description: A feature makes an outbound HTTP call to a user-supplied URL and returns the response, enabling SSRF to internal services.
findings.scanner_baseline: Partially: Semgrep flagged merchant/views.py:87 as disabled-cert-validation (CWE-295 TLS), not the SSRF (attacker-controlled URL)

findings.title: NoSQL injection: redeem coupons without a valid code
findings.description: Coupon validation is vulnerable to NoSQL injection, allowing free coupons without knowing the code.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: SQL injection: redeem an already-claimed coupon
findings.description: Coupon redemption query is vulnerable to SQL injection, allowing modification of the database to re-redeem coupons.
findings.scanner_baseline: DETECTED by Semgrep: High, sqlalchemy-execute-raw-query + tainted-sql-string at shop/views.py:388-389

findings.title: Unauthenticated access: endpoint performs no auth check
findings.description: An endpoint performs no authentication check and is reachable by anonymous users.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: JWT forgery: accept tokens with weak/none algorithm
findings.description: JWT validation accepts forgeable tokens (algorithm confusion / weak key / none), granting full platform access to any actor.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

findings.title: LLM prompt injection in chatbot enables client-side injection
findings.description: Chatbot is vulnerable to prompt injection leading to client-side rendering injection.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected (Semgrep flagged Flask debug host binding in the service, not the prompt injection)

findings.title: LLM chatbot leaks another user's credentials
findings.description: Chatbot can be induced to disclose another user's credentials, enabling account access.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected (Semgrep flagged Flask debug host binding in the service, not the SQL-toolkit abuse)

findings.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file read (path traversal)
findings.description: DownloadReportView.get has no auth decorator. validate_filename runs on the raw input (which permits %HH sequences), then unquote() decodes it, so %2e%2e%2f passes the check and becomes ../ before os.path.join. Unauthenticated arbitrary file read.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected (Semgrep flagged csrf-exempt and Jinja2 elsewhere in the file, not the traversal at line 381)

findings.title: Unauthenticated order and customer disclosure via order ID
findings.description: OrderControlView.get (line 109) has no auth decorator while the post/put on the same class do. Returns order data for any order_id with no ownership check. Unauthenticated cross-tenant read.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected (Semgrep flagged TLS and SQLi elsewhere in the file, not the missing auth at line 109)

findings.title: Unauthenticated service-request creation
findings.description: ReceiveReportView.get (line 169) has no auth decorator and creates a ServiceRequest from query params (mechanic_code, vin, problem_details). Unauthenticated write with limited blast radius.
findings.scanner_baseline: Not detected by Semgrep or Trivy

scanner_baseline_totals.app_vulns_detected: 1 of 20 (F13 SQL injection). The other 19, including every pre-auth account takeover, three unauthenticated workshop endpoints, and the mass-assignment to RCE chain, are absent from all 1031 findings.

method_columns.i_static_scans: Semgrep OSS + Trivy fs, real run 2026-08-26. See scans/ and scanner_baseline per finding.
method_columns.ii_frontier_ai: Impact-in-the-abstract severity from a frontier model (Claude Opus 4.8) reading the code, corroborated by STRIDE-GPT's autonomous 74-threat agentic run. No reachability or chaining.
method_columns.iii_prioritisation_skill: Reachability + trust-boundary + chaining ranking. See crapi-triage-result.md Priority column.
